changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO realm_attribute (name, realm_id, value) SELECT 'openidFederationEntityTypes' AS name, fed.realm_id, o.value FROM openid_federation_attribute o JOIN openid_federation fed ON fed.internal_id = o.openid_federation_id WHERE o.name = 'openidFederationEntityTypes' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO realm_attribute (name, realm_id, value) SELECT 'openidFederationEntityTypes' AS name, fed.realm_id, o.value FROM openid_federation_attribute o JOIN openid_federation fed ON fed.internal_id = o.openid_federation_id WHERE o.name = 'openidFederationEntityTypes' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY;

changeSet.author: cgeorgilakis@grnet.gr
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO realm_attribute (name, realm_id, value) SELECT CASE WHEN et.value = 'OPENID_PROVIDER' THEN 'openidFederationOPClientRegistrationTypesSupported' WHEN et.value = 'OPENID_RELYING_PARTY' THEN 'openidFederationRPClientRegistrationTypesSupported' ELSE 'openidFederationClientRegistrationTypesSupported' END AS name, fed.realm_id, o.value FROM openid_federation_attribute o JOIN openid_federation fed ON fed.internal_id = o.openid_federation_id JOIN realm_attribute et ON et.realm_id = fed.realm_id AND et.name = 'openidFederationEntityTypes' WHERE o.name = 'openidFederationClientRegistrationTypesSupported' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO realm_attribute (name, realm_id, value) SELECT CASE WHEN et.value = 'OPENID_PROVIDER' THEN 'openidFederationOPClientRegistrationTypesSupported' WHEN et.value = 'OPENID_RELYING_PARTY' THEN 'openidFederationRPClientRegistrationTypesSupported' ELSE 'openidFederationClientRegistrationTypesSupported' END AS name, fed.realm_id, o.value FROM openid_federation_attribute o JOIN openid_federation fed ON fed.internal_id = o.openid_federation_id JOIN realm_attribute et ON et.realm_id = fed.realm_id AND et.name = 'openidFederationEntityTypes' WHERE o.name = 'openidFederationClientRegistrationTypesSupported' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY;
